name: separate-crate-e2e-cli-reachable-scope
body: Limit: this e2e pins only the CLI-reachable planned-node realization contract — a planned node in a separate cargo project realizes like the root crate through an ordinary scan sequence. It does not exercise the cached-fact-assembly path, where splice_cached discards the cached real declaration at a planned placeholder's FQN and the assembled graph keeps the placeholder row; that masking is a demonstrated defect whose replacement contract is stated by requirement planned-node-realizes-through-the-cached-fact-assembly. Upgrade when the assembly path's realization is fixed and pinned: extend this test (or a sibling) to drive a planned placeholder against a cached, unchanged declaration and assert realization.
